intro.text: The Lord Farmer of Lossand and one of the Taishin, who leads its farmers from the Farmer's Congress.

items.text: In the Taishin's first vote, Gennel voted to dissolve the Diem, calling sand mastery too dangerous. He was unavailable when N'Teese tried to set up a meeting for Khriss.

Hunting for Vey, Kenton lifted Gennel's assistant into the air with sand and threatened him. Terrified of angering Vey, Gennel begged not to be made to tell; Kenton relented and asked politely, but Gennel still refused.
In the final vote he backed the Diem, apparently because he always follows Vey's lead.

appearance.text: Broad-shouldered, with red hair to his shoulders and a thick, full red beard.
